bg-25-01.hint: It would be best to rest at home today.
bg-25-01.why: -는 게 좋겠다 offers gentle, caring advice: 쉬- + -는 게 좋겠어요.

bg-25-01.q: Give gentle advice that it is good to drink warm water using 따뜻한 물 and 마시는 게 좋아요.
bg-25-01.why: Action verbs take -는 게 좋아요 to offer considerate recommendations.

base.en: It would be good to rest.

steps.en: It would be good to rest at home.
It would be good to rest at home today.

ko: 친구가 감기에 걸려서 기침을 자주 해요.
저는 친구에게 오늘은 무리하지 말고 일찍 쉬는 게 좋겠다고 했어요.
그리고 따뜻한 유자차도 한 잔 건넸어요.
en: My friend caught a cold and coughs frequently.
I told my friend that it would be best not to overwork and rest early today.
And I also handed over a cup of warm citron tea.

bg-25-01.q: Why does the friend cough often?
options: Because of dust in the room
bg-25-01.why: The text states '친구가 감기에 걸려서 기침을 자주 해요' (My friend caught a cold and coughs frequently).

bg-25-01.q: What caring advice did the writer give?
bg-25-01.why: The text says '무리하지 말고 일찍 쉬는 게 좋겠다고 했어요' (I told them it would be best not to overwork and rest early).

items: Offer warm and polite recommendations with -는 게 좋다 / 좋겠다
Replace blunt commands with softer advice in interpersonal relationships

bg-25-02.hint: I hope the weather is good this weekend.
bg-25-02.why: Wishes use -았/었으면 좋겠다: 좋다 + -았으면 좋겠어요 → 좋았으면 좋겠어요.

bg-25-02.q: Express your wish that vacation comes soon using 방학이 and 왔으면 좋겠어요.
bg-25-02.why: 오다 has vowel ㅗ, taking -았으면 좋겠어요 → 왔으면 좋겠어요.

base.en: I wish it would be good.

steps.en: I wish the weather would be good.
I wish the weather would be good this weekend.

ko: 다음 주에 중요한 한국어 시험이 있어요.
열심히 공부했으니까 꼭 좋은 성적으로 합격했으면 좋겠어요.
시험이 끝나면 친구들과 여행도 가고 싶어요.
en: I have an important Korean exam next week.
Since I studied hard, I really hope I pass with great grades.
When the exam finishes, I want to travel with my friends too.

bg-25-02.q: What is the writer's wish regarding the exam?
bg-25-02.why: The text states '꼭 좋은 성적으로 합격했으면 좋겠어요' (I really hope I pass with great grades).

bg-25-02.q: What does the writer want to do after the exam?
bg-25-02.why: The text states '시험이 끝나면 친구들과 여행도 가고 싶어요' (When the exam finishes, I want to travel with my friends too).

items: Express heartfelt hopes and future wishes using -았/었으면 좋겠다
Formulate wishes regarding unpredictable events like weather or test results

bg-25-03.hint: I hope your cold gets better quickly.
bg-25-03.why: 낫다 drops ㅅ before vowel endings: 나- + -았으면 좋겠어요 → 나았으면 좋겠어요.

bg-25-03.q: Express a wish to hear good news using 좋은 소식을 and 들었으면 좋겠어요.
bg-25-03.why: 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel endings: 들었으면 좋겠어요.

bg-25-03.wrong: 친구가 아파서 감기가 빨리 낫았으면 좋겠어요.
answers: 친구가 아파서 감기가 빨리 나았으면 좋겠어요.
친구가 아파서 감기가 빨리 나았으면 좋겠어요
bg-25-03.hint: 낫다 is a ㅅ-irregular verb; before a vowel, the ㅅ drops: 낫- + -았으면 → 나았으면.
bg-25-03.why: ㅅ drops before vowels: 낫다 becomes 나았으면 좋겠어요.

steps.en: I hope your cold gets better quickly.
I hope my friend's cold gets better quickly.

ko: 친구가 며칠 전부터 심한 독감에 걸려 고생하고 있어요.
친구가 아프지 않고 빨리 나았으면 좋겠어요.
내일은 친구 집 앞에 따뜻한 죽을 가져다주려고 해요.
en: My friend has been suffering from a bad flu for a few days.
I hope my friend stops hurting and recovers quickly.
Tomorrow I plan to bring warm porridge to my friend's house.

bg-25-03.why: The text states '친구가 며칠 전부터 심한 독감에 걸려 고생하고 있어요' (My friend has been suffering from a bad flu).

bg-25-03.q: What does the writer plan to bring to the friend tomorrow?
bg-25-03.why: The text states '내일은 친구 집 앞에 따뜻한 죽을 가져다주려고 해요' (Tomorrow I plan to bring warm porridge to my friend's house).

items: Conjugate irregular stems (ㅅ-drop, ㄷ-irregular) accurately with -았/었으면 좋겠다
Offer comforting wishes for quick recovery and health to friends

bg-25-04.say: 스트레스 받을 때는 좋아하는 음악을 듣는 게 좋아요
answers: 스트레스 받을 때는 좋아하는 음악을 듣는 게 좋아요
스트레스받을 때는 좋아하는 음악을 듣는 게 좋아요
bg-25-04.hint: When stressed, it is good to listen to music you like.

bg-25-04.q: Give caring advice to go to bed early when tired using 일찍 and 자는 게 좋아요.
bg-25-04.sample: 피곤할 때는 일찍 자는 게 좋아요.
bg-25-04.why: Attach -는 게 좋아요 to advise the best action.

bg-25-04.wrong: 내일 시험 결과가 잘 나오면 좋겠어요.
answers: 내일 시험 결과가 잘 나왔으면 좋겠어요.
내일 시험 결과가 잘 나왔으면 좋겠어요
bg-25-04.hint: Wishes about outcomes require the past-tense shape -았/었으면: 나오- + -았으면 → 나왔으면 좋겠어요.
bg-25-04.why: The wish pattern requires -았/었으면 좋겠다: 나왔으면 좋겠어요.

bg-25-04.h: Gentle Advice -는 게 좋다 vs Hopeful Wish -았/었으면 좋겠다

a.d: Gives gentle, caring advice to someone (*“It would be best to...”* or *“You had better...”*).
ex: 열이 나면 약을 **먹는 게 좋아요**. — If you have a fever, it's best to take medicine.
오늘은 무리하지 말고 **쉬는 게 좋겠어요**. — You should take it easy and rest today.

b.d: Expresses a personal hope or wish about future circumstances (*“I hope that...”* or *“I wish...”*).
ex: 내일은 날씨가 **따뜻했으면 좋겠어요**. — I hope the weather will be warm tomorrow.
이번 시험에 꼭 **합격했으면 좋겠어요**. — I hope to pass this exam.

bg-25-04.tip: Use -는 게 좋아요 when telling a person what action is best for them to take; use -았/었으면 좋겠어요 for personal wishes, weather, and uncontrollable events.

steps.en: It's good to listen to music.
When stressed, it's good to listen to music.

ko: 그럴 때는 억지로 밤새우지 말고 일찍 자는 게 좋아요.
그리고 모두 시험을 잘 치르고 기분 좋게 방학을 맞이했으면 좋겠어요.
en: Anyone experiences stress during exam periods.
At such times, it's best not to force yourself to stay up all night and sleep early.
And I hope everyone does well on exams and welcomes vacation cheerfully.

bg-25-04.q: What advice does the writer give for exam stress?
options: Not staying up all night and sleeping early
bg-25-04.why: The text states '억지로 밤새우지 말고 일찍 자는 게 좋아요' (It's best not to force yourself to stay up all night and sleep early).

bg-25-04.q: What wish does the writer express for all students?
options: To do well on exams and enjoy vacation
bg-25-04.why: The text states '모두 시험을 잘 치르고 기분 좋게 방학을 맞이했으면 좋겠어요' (I hope everyone does well on exams and welcomes vacation cheerfully).

items: Distinguish advice (-는 게 좋다), wishes (-았/었으면 좋겠다), and obligations (-아/어야 하다)
Select the most appropriate communicative tone when encouraging friends and family
